name: Dumbbell Alternating Curl
summary: A classic arm exercise curling one dumbbell at a time. Alternating sides lets you focus on each arm and keep your torso still.
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward or in.
Keep your elbows beside your torso and your shoulders relaxed.
Brace your abs lightly to avoid leaning.
execution: Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder, rotating your palm to face up as it rises.
Keep your upper arm still and your elbow close to your side.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until the arm is straight.
cues: Palm turns up as you curl
mistakes: Swinging the torso to lift the weight: use lighter dumbbells and keep your glutes tight.
Elbows drifting forward: keep them beside your ribs.
Dropping the weight on the way down: take two to three seconds to lower.
Cutting the range of motion: lower until the arm is nearly straight each rep.
